user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I want to create a fun and engaging atmosphere. Fetch me the top quality memes from Reddit and the newest trending memes using the Reddit meme API. Also, search for funny posts and comments on Reddit related to work life using the Socialgrep API.

Fetch the newest trending memes from Reddit using the meme API.
